"""Task-local persistent ASR runner: pinned inputs, resource accounting, no cloud."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import ctypes
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import queue
import random
import resource
import shutil
import signal
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO = ROOT.parent.parent


def load_module(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


energy_module = load_module("screen_energy", REPO / "bench/autoresearch/energy_sampler.py")
mem_module = load_module("screen_memory", REPO / "bench/autoresearch/mem_sampler.py")


def sha(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open("rb") as handle:
        for part in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(part)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def audio_pin(rows):
    digest = hashlib.sha256(b"voiceour-audio-manifest-v1\0")
    for row in rows:
        name = row["id"].encode()
        digest.update(struct.pack(">Q", len(name)))
        digest.update(name)
        digest.update(struct.pack(">Q", row["audio_bytes"]))
        digest.update(bytes.fromhex(row["audio_sha256"]))
    digest.update(struct.pack(">Q", len(rows)))
    return digest.hexdigest()


def command_text(argv):
    result = subprocess.run(argv, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=10)
    return {"exit_code": result.returncode, "stdout": result.stdout.strip(), "stderr": result.stderr.strip()}


class MemoryMonitor:
    def __init__(self, pid):
        self.pid = pid
        self.lib = mem_module._libsystem()
        timebase = (ctypes.c_uint32 * 2)()
        if self.lib.mach_timebase_info(ctypes.byref(timebase)) != 0 or timebase[1] == 0:
            raise RuntimeError("mach timebase unavailable for proc_pid_rusage CPU counters")
        self.timebase_numer, self.timebase_denom = timebase
        self.stop = threading.Event()
        self.peak_rss = 0
        self.peak_phys = 0
        self.samples = 0
        self.cpu_ticks = 0
        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self._run, daemon=True)
        self.thread.start()

    def _capture(self, buffer):
        if self.lib.proc_pid_rusage(self.pid, 0, ctypes.byref(buffer)) == 0:
            user, system = struct.unpack_from("<QQ", buffer, 16)
            resident, physical = struct.unpack_from("<QQ", buffer, 64)
            self.peak_rss = max(self.peak_rss, resident)
            self.peak_phys = max(self.peak_phys, physical)
            self.cpu_ticks = user + system
            self.samples += 1

    def _run(self):
        buffer = ctypes.create_string_buffer(mem_module.RUSAGE_INFO_V0_SIZE)
        while not self.stop.is_set():
            self._capture(buffer)
            self.stop.wait(0.020)

    def finish(self):
        self.stop.set()
        self.thread.join(timeout=2)
        self._capture(ctypes.create_string_buffer(mem_module.RUSAGE_INFO_V0_SIZE))
        lifetime_buffer = ctypes.create_string_buffer(296)
        lifetime_peak = None
        if self.lib.proc_pid_rusage(self.pid, 4, ctypes.byref(lifetime_buffer)) == 0:
            lifetime_peak = struct.unpack_from("<Q", lifetime_buffer, 240)[0]
        return {"measured_pid": self.pid, "peak_resident_bytes": self.peak_rss,
                "peak_physical_footprint_bytes": self.peak_phys, "samples": self.samples,
                "lifetime_max_physical_footprint_bytes": lifetime_peak,
                "lifetime_max_source": "rusage_info_v4 flavor4 offset240 size296, SDK layout compiled and checked",
                "cpu_raw_ticks": self.cpu_ticks,
                "cpu_timebase_numer": self.timebase_numer, "cpu_timebase_denom": self.timebase_denom,
                "cpu_seconds": self.cpu_ticks * self.timebase_numer / self.timebase_denom / 1e9,
                "sample_interval_ms": 20,
                "scope": "Known inference process; CPU time includes load; accelerator/system-server allocations may be excluded"}


class Runner:
    def __init__(self, descriptor, prefix, ready_timeout):
        self.descriptor = descriptor
        self.prefix = prefix
        self.queue = queue.Queue()
        self.stderr = prefix.with_name(prefix.name + ".stderr.log").open("xb")
        self.stdout = prefix.with_name(prefix.name + ".stdout.log").open("xb")
        env = {k: os.environ[k] for k in ("PATH", "HOME", "TMPDIR", "SSL_CERT_FILE", "DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH") if k in os.environ}
        env.update({"HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY": "1", "HF_HUB_DISABLE_IMPLICIT_TOKEN": "1",
                    "HF_HUB_OFFLINE": "1", "TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE": "1", "DO_NOT_TRACK": "1",
                    "TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM": "false", "OMP_NUM_THREADS": "4",
                    "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS": "4", "VOICEOUR_ASR_LOG": "error"})
        env.update({str(k): str(v) for k, v in descriptor.get("env", {}).items()})
        started = time.perf_counter_ns()
        self.spawn_started_ns = started
        self.process = subprocess.Popen(descriptor["command"], cwd=descriptor.get("cwd", str(REPO)),
                                        env=env, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                                        stderr=self.stderr, start_new_session=True)
        self.memory = MemoryMonitor(self.process.pid)
        self.reader = threading.Thread(target=self._read, daemon=True)
        self.reader.start()
        try:
            self.ready = self.receive(ready_timeout)
            if self.ready.get("type") != "ready":
                raise RuntimeError(f"expected ready, received {self.ready}")
            self.process_ready_ms = (time.perf_counter_ns() - started) / 1e6
            self.request_count = 0
            measured_pid = self.ready.get("measured_pid")
            self.wrapper_memory = None
            if measured_pid and measured_pid != self.process.pid:
                self.wrapper_memory = self.memory.finish()
                self.memory = MemoryMonitor(int(measured_pid))
        except BaseException:
            self.close(force=True)
            raise

    def _read(self):
        try:
            for line in self.process.stdout:
                self.stdout.write(line)
                self.stdout.flush()
                try:
                    self.queue.put(json.loads(line))
                except Exception:
                    self.queue.put({"type": "protocol_error", "line": line.decode("utf8", errors="replace")[:2000]})
        finally:
            self.queue.put({"type": "eof"})

    def receive(self, timeout):
        try:
            value = self.queue.get(timeout=timeout)
        except queue.Empty:
            raise TimeoutError(f"runner exceeded {timeout}s") from None
        if value.get("type") in ("protocol_error", "eof"):
            raise RuntimeError(value)
        return value

    def request(self, row, timeout):
        started = time.perf_counter_ns()
        first_in_session = self.request_count == 0
        self.request_count += 1
        data = json.dumps({"id": row["id"], "audio_path": row["audio_path"]}).encode() + b"\n"
        self.process.stdin.write(data)
        self.process.stdin.flush()
        result = self.receive(timeout)
        finished = time.perf_counter_ns()
        elapsed = (finished - started) / 1e6
        if result.get("id") != row["id"]:
            raise RuntimeError(f"request identity mismatch: {row['id']} / {result.get('id')}")
        if result.get("type") not in ("result", "error"):
            raise RuntimeError(f"unexpected response type: {result}")
        if result.get("type") == "result":
            if not isinstance(result.get("text"), str) or not isinstance(result.get("inference_ms"), (float, int)):
                raise RuntimeError(f"missing text/timing contract: {result}")
        result["request_wall_ms"] = elapsed
        result["first_in_session"] = first_in_session
        if first_in_session:
            result["spawn_to_first_response_ms"] = (finished - self.spawn_started_ns) / 1e6
        return result

    def close(self, force=False):
        memory = self.memory.finish() if hasattr(self, "memory") else {}
        process = getattr(self, "process", None)
        if process is not None:
            try:
                process.stdin.close()
            except (BrokenPipeError, OSError):
                pass
            try:
                process.wait(timeout=10 if not force else 0.1)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                try:
                    process.wait(timeout=5)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                    process.wait(timeout=5)
            if hasattr(self, "reader"):
                self.reader.join(timeout=1)
        for handle in (getattr(self, "stdout", None), getattr(self, "stderr", None)):
            if handle:
                handle.close()
        return memory


def finish_session(runner, reason, force=False):
    memory = runner.close(force=force)
    return {"reason": reason, "ready": runner.ready, "process_ready_ms": runner.process_ready_ms,
            "memory": memory, "wrapper_memory": getattr(runner, "wrapper_memory", None),
            "exit_code": runner.process.returncode}


def combined_memory(sessions):
    records = [s["memory"] for s in sessions]
    if not records:
        return None
    return {"peak_resident_bytes": max(r["peak_resident_bytes"] for r in records),
            "peak_physical_footprint_bytes": max(r["peak_physical_footprint_bytes"] for r in records),
            "lifetime_max_physical_footprint_bytes": max(
                (r["lifetime_max_physical_footprint_bytes"] for r in records if r.get("lifetime_max_physical_footprint_bytes") is not None),
                default=None),
            "cpu_seconds": sum(r["cpu_seconds"] for r in records),
            "sessions": len(records), "sample_interval_ms": 20,
            "scope": "Maximum of sequential inference-process peaks; summed CPU time includes loads. Accelerator/system-server allocations may be excluded."}

"""Execute explicitly listed measurement jobs serially; preserve every failure."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('plan', type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    plan = json.loads(args.plan.read_text())
    events = args.plan.with_suffix('.events.jsonl')
    if events.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(events)
    with events.open('x') as log:
        for index, job in enumerate(plan['jobs']):
            started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
            before = time.monotonic()
            print(json.dumps({'event':'start','index':index,'label':job['label'],'at':started}),flush=True)
            prefix = Path(job['prefix'])
            prefix.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            with prefix.with_name(prefix.name + '.command.log').open('x') as output:
                # The orchestration child owns bounded startup/request watchdogs and
                # tears down its inference process group. Do not kill that owner
                # from an outer timeout and leave its model process orphaned.
                completed = subprocess.run(job['command'],cwd=plan['cwd'],stdout=output,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                                           start_new_session=False)
                code = completed.returncode
                error = None
            record={'index':index,'label':job['label'],'started_at':started,'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-before,
                    'exit_code':code,'error':error,'command':job['command'],'command_log':str(prefix.with_name(prefix.name + '.command.log'))}
            log.write(json.dumps(record)+'\n')
            log.flush()
            print(json.dumps(record),flush=True)
    return 0


if __name__=='__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())

not repeat the interrupted long request or prove in-decode/kernel cancellation.

def cancellation_semantics(descriptor, requested):
    if not requested:
        return {'requested': False, 'scope': 'Not exercised by this scenario set.'}
    command_names = [Path(str(value)).name for value in descriptor['command']]
    if 'sidecar_runner.py' in command_names:
        scope = (
            'NDJSON protocol cancel sent approximately 1ms after transcribe submission, '
            'before or during audio reading/decode; exact backend execution phase is not observed. '
            'A cancelled terminal proves protocol handling, not in-kernel interruption. '
            'Cancellation latency includes protocol/backend response work.'
        )
    elif 'native_runner.py' in command_names:
        scope = (
            'Adapter installs a native abort callback with a 1ms deadline from inference start. '
            'A normal result remains a cancellation failure even if recovery text matches.'
        )
    else:
        scope = (
            'Adapter-specific cancel_after_ms=1 request; no universal protocol or kernel-phase '
            'claim. The response and adapter-ready metadata retain the actual semantics.'
        )
    return {'requested': True, 'scope': scope, 'comparable_across_engines': False}


def final_status(result):
    if result.get('failure') or result.get('cleanup_failures'):
        return 'failed'
    required = [check['passed'] for check in result['transcript_identity_checks'].values()
                if check['applicable']]
    if result['blockers'] or any(value is None for value in required):
        return 'blocked'
    return ('passed' if all(step['passed'] for step in result['steps'])
            and all(value is True for value in required) else 'observed-failures')

    started = time.perf_counter_ns()
    runner.process.stdin.write(json.dumps(request).encode() + b'\n')
    runner.process.stdin.flush()
    response = runner.receive(timeout)
    if response.get('id') != request['id']:
        raise RuntimeError(f"response identity mismatch: {request['id']} / {response.get('id')}")
    return response, (time.perf_counter_ns()-started)/1e6

            finally:

    def probe(name, path, expected, extra=None):

"""Task-local owned-group termination measurements; no privileged fallbacks.

Only a Popen-owned, separately created session may receive SIGKILL. A successful
leader wait is not proof that its descendants or process group have disappeared.
Darwin can return EPERM from signal-zero on an exiting/zombie-only group; retain
that observation and require eventual ESRCH rather than interpreting EPERM as
success. Persistent EPERM remains a blocker, not a signing diagnosis.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import fcntl
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import signal
import subprocess

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def inspect_owned_pids(pids):
    """Inspect only recorded PIDs, never enumerate or signal other processes."""
    completed = subprocess.run(
        ["ps", "-p", ",".join(str(pid) for pid in sorted(set(pids))),
         "-o", "pid=,ppid=,pgid=,uid=,stat=,comm="],
        text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=5,
    )
    if completed.returncode not in (0, 1) or completed.stderr.strip():
        raise RuntimeError(f"owned PID inspection failed: {completed.stderr.strip()}")
    rows = []
    for line in completed.stdout.splitlines():
        fields = line.strip().split(None, 5)
        if len(fields) != 6:
            raise RuntimeError(f"invalid owned PID observation: {line!r}")
        pid, ppid, pgid, uid = (int(value) for value in fields[:4])
        rows.append({"pid": pid, "ppid": ppid, "pgid": pgid, "uid": uid,
                     "state": fields[4], "command": fields[5]})
    return rows


class OwnedProcessGroup:
    def __init__(self, process, measured_pid=None):
        self.process = process
        self.pgid = process.pid
        self.pids = [process.pid]
        if measured_pid is not None and int(measured_pid) != process.pid:
            self.pids.append(int(measured_pid))
        self.before = inspect_owned_pids(self.pids)
        self.ownership_error = None
        leader = next((row for row in self.before if row["pid"] == process.pid), None)
        if process.poll() is not None:
            self.ownership_error = "owned leader exited before ownership observation"
        elif leader is None or leader["ppid"] != os.getpid():
            self.ownership_error = "leader is not the recorded direct Popen child"
        else:
            try:
                if os.getpgid(process.pid) != self.pgid or os.getsid(process.pid) != self.pgid:
                    self.ownership_error = "owned leader is not its own group/session leader"
            except ProcessLookupError:
                self.ownership_error = "owned leader exited during ownership observation"
        for pid in self.pids:
            row = next((item for item in self.before if item["pid"] == pid), None)
            if row is None:
                self.ownership_error = f"recorded owned PID {pid} already exited"
            elif row["uid"] != os.getuid() or row["pgid"] != self.pgid:
                self.ownership_error = f"recorded owned PID {pid} has unexpected uid/group"
            elif pid != process.pid and row["ppid"] != process.pid:
                self.ownership_error = f"measured PID {pid} is not the owned leader's child"

    def terminate(self, timeout=5.0, target='process-group'):
        started = time.perf_counter_ns()
        observation = {
            "passed": False, "owned_process_group": self.pgid,
            "owned_pids": self.pids, "ownership_before": self.before,
            "ownership_error": self.ownership_error, "signal": "SIGKILL",
            "termination_target": target,
            "target_pid": self.pids[-1] if target == 'measured-child' else None,
            "signal_sent": False, "leader_preexited": self.process.poll() is not None,
            "leader_exit_code": None, "kill_to_leader_exit_ms": None,
            "kill_to_group_gone_ms": None, "group_gone": False,
            "group_observation_errors": [], "group_observation_error_count": 0,
            "condition_deadline_s": timeout,
        }
        if self.ownership_error and not observation["leader_preexited"]:
            observation["outcome"] = "ownership-not-proven"
            observation["blocker"] = self.ownership_error
            return observation
        if target not in ('process-group', 'measured-child') or (
                target == 'measured-child' and len(self.pids) != 2):
            observation['outcome'] = 'target-not-proven'
            observation['blocker'] = 'measured-child termination requires a verified distinct direct child'
            return observation
        if observation["leader_preexited"]:
            observation["outcome"] = "already-exited-before-signal"
        else:
            try:
                if target == 'process-group':
                    started = time.perf_counter_ns()
                    os.killpg(self.pgid, signal.SIGKILL)
                else:
                    current = inspect_owned_pids(self.pids)
                    child = next((row for row in current if row['pid'] == self.pids[-1]), None)
                    original = next(row for row in self.before if row['pid'] == self.pids[-1])
                    stable_fields = ('pid', 'ppid', 'pgid', 'uid', 'command')
                    if child is None or any(child[key] != original[key] for key in stable_fields):
                        observation['outcome'] = 'target-ownership-changed'
                        observation['blocker'] = 'recorded measured-child ownership changed before SIGKILL'
                        return observation
                    if child['state'].startswith('Z'):
                        observation['outcome'] = 'measured-child-already-exited'
                        observation['blocker'] = 'recorded helper was already a zombie; no successful forced kill claimed'
                        return observation
                    observation['ownership_at_signal'] = current
                    started = time.perf_counter_ns()
                    os.kill(self.pids[-1], signal.SIGKILL)
                observation["signal_sent"] = True
                observation["outcome"] = "signal-sent"
                if target == 'measured-child':
                    # The adapter remains alive to reap its child. EOF is adapter
                    # shutdown only; it is never credited as the target kill.
                    try:
                        self.process.stdin.close()
                    except OSError as exc:
                        observation['leader_stdin_close_error'] = repr(exc)
                    observation['leader_stdin_closed_after_target_kill'] = True
            except ProcessLookupError as exc:
                observation["outcome"] = "already-exited-at-signal"
                observation["signal_error"] = repr(exc)
            except PermissionError as exc:
                observation["outcome"] = "signal-permission-blocked"
                observation["signal_error"] = repr(exc)
                observation["blocker"] = "SIGKILL was denied; no privileged fallback or second target attempted"
        deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
        while True:
            exit_code = self.process.poll()  # Reap our leader, independently of group lifetime.
            elapsed_ms = (time.perf_counter_ns() - started) / 1e6
            if exit_code is not None and observation["leader_exit_code"] is None:
                observation["leader_exit_code"] = exit_code
                if observation["signal_sent"]:
                    observation["kill_to_leader_exit_ms"] = elapsed_ms
            try:
                os.killpg(self.pgid, 0)
            except ProcessLookupError:
                observation["group_gone"] = True
                if observation["signal_sent"]:
                    observation["kill_to_group_gone_ms"] = (time.perf_counter_ns() - started) / 1e6
            except PermissionError as exc:
                observation["group_observation_error_count"] += 1
                if not observation["group_observation_errors"]:
                    observation["group_observation_errors"].append({
                        "operation": "killpg(signal=0)", "error": repr(exc),
                        "first_observed_ms": elapsed_ms,
                    })
            if observation["group_gone"] and exit_code is not None:
                break
            remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
            if remaining <= 0:
                observation.setdefault("blocker", "owned group/leader disappearance was not proven before deadline")
                break
            # Bounded measurement condition loop, not a fixed completion assumption.
            time.sleep(min(0.010, remaining))
        observation["ownership_after"] = inspect_owned_pids(self.pids)
        observation["passed"] = (
            observation["signal_sent"] and observation["group_gone"]
            and (observation["leader_exit_code"] == -signal.SIGKILL
                 if target == 'process-group' else observation["leader_exit_code"] is not None)
            and not observation["ownership_after"] and "blocker" not in observation
        )
        if observation["passed"]:
            observation["outcome"] = ('owned-group-killed-and-gone' if target == 'process-group'
                                      else 'owned-measured-child-killed-and-group-gone')
        elif observation["signal_sent"] and "blocker" not in observation:
            observation["blocker"] = "SIGKILL/group disappearance did not establish every recorded owned process exited"
        return observation


def smoke(output):
    """Parent-run, inference-free real process measurements, under the same lock."""
    if output.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(output)
    lock = (ROOT / "accelerator.lock").open("a+")
    fcntl.flock(lock.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX)
    cases = []
    worker = (
        "import os,signal,subprocess,sys; "
        "child=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-c',"
        "'import time; time.sleep(60)']) if sys.argv[1]=='child' else None; "
        "print(child.pid if child else os.getpid(),flush=True); sys.stdin.readline(); "
        "child.wait() if child else None"
    )
    try:
        for name, child, preexit, target in (
                ("single-owned-process", False, False, 'process-group'),
                ("owned-leader-and-child", True, False, 'process-group'),
                ("owned-measured-child", True, False, 'measured-child'),
                ("owned-process-preexited", False, True, 'process-group')):
            process = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-u", "-c", worker,
                                        "child" if child else "single"],
                                       stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                                       start_new_session=True)
            measured_pid = int(process.stdout.readline())
            group = OwnedProcessGroup(process, measured_pid)
            if preexit:
                process.stdin.close()
                process.wait(timeout=5)
            result = group.terminate(target=target)
            result["case"] = name
            result["expected_observation"] = (
                result["group_gone"] and not result["signal_sent"] and not result["passed"]
                if preexit else result["passed"]
            )
            cases.append(result)
            process.stdin.close()
            process.stdout.close()
            if not result["group_gone"]:
                break  # Never overlap a new group with an unconfirmed prior teardown.
        record = {"scope": "Inference-free owned-process smoke; no model/ASR claims",
                  "cases": cases, "passed": len(cases) == 4 and all(case["expected_observation"] for case in cases)}
        with output.open("x") as handle:
            json.dump(record, handle, indent=2)
            handle.write("\n")
        print(json.dumps({"passed": record["passed"], "output": str(output)}), flush=True)
        return 0 if record["passed"] else 1
    finally:
        fcntl.flock(lock.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_UN)
        lock.close()

def sha(path):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as handle:
        for block in iter(lambda:handle.read(1024*1024),b''):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()


def local(path):

def digest(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()

    words = jiwer.process_words(ref, hyp)
    chars = jiwer.process_characters(ref, hyp)
    sr, sh = strict_words(reference), strict_words(hypothesis)
    strict = jiwer.process_words(" ".join(sr), " ".join(sh))

    case = metrics.case_f1([formatted_reference], [hypothesis]) if has_format else None

def no_speech_output(row, stage):
    text = row[stage + "_text"]

    # angle-bracketed model text. Keep its exact spelling in all API evidence.
    tokens = ["<|nospeech|>"] if row["candidate"].startswith("granite5-turboctc-470m-oct21-") else []
    present = [token for token in tokens if token in text]
    residue = text
    for token in present:
        residue = residue.replace(token, "")
    control_only = bool(present) and all(c.isspace() or unicodedata.category(c).startswith("P") for c in residue)
    if row["error"] == "missing_result":
        category = "missing_result"
    elif row["error"] is not None:
        has_partial = any(isinstance(value, str) and value.strip() for value in (partial, api_text))
        category = "error_with_partial_text" if has_partial else "error_without_partial_text"
    elif not text.strip():
        category = "clean_empty"
    elif control_only:
        category = "special_control_only"
    else:

    return {"id": row["id"], "category": category, "text": text,
            "api_text": api_text, "api_partial_text": partial, "error": row["error"],
            "special_controls_present": present,
            "non_control_lexical_words": strict_words(residue),

class Postprocessor:
    def __init__(self, binary, vocabulary):
        self.proc = subprocess.Popen([str(binary), "--vocabulary", str(vocabulary)],
                                     stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                                     text=True, encoding="utf-8", bufsize=1)
        self.ready = self.receive()
        if self.ready.get("type") != "postprocessor_ready" or self.ready.get("vocabulary_sha256") != digest(vocabulary):
            self.proc.kill()
            self.proc.wait()
            raise ValueError("Native postprocessor did not attest the exact vocabulary snapshot")
        self.cache = {}

    def receive(self):
        line = self.proc.stdout.readline()
        if not line:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Native postprocessor exited unexpectedly ({self.proc.poll()})")
        return json.loads(line)

    def process(self, text):
        if text not in self.cache:
            row_id = str(len(self.cache))
            self.proc.stdin.write(json.dumps({"id": row_id, "text": text}, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
            self.proc.stdin.flush()
            result = self.receive()
            if result.get("type") != "postprocessed" or result.get("id") != row_id or result.get("raw_text") != text:
                raise ValueError(f"Native postprocessing failed: {result}")
            self.cache[text] = result
        return self.cache[text]

    def close(self):
        self.proc.stdin.close()
        status = self.proc.wait(timeout=30)
        if status:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Native postprocessor exited {status}")

            raise ValueError(f"{path}: descriptor missing exact {key}")
    if d["candidate"] != candidate or str(d["revision"]).lower() in ("main", "master", "head", "latest"):
        raise ValueError(f"{path}: candidate identity mismatch or unpinned revision")
    if not isinstance(d["command"], list) or not all(isinstance(v, str) for v in d["command"]):
        raise ValueError(f"{path}: command must be argv")
    if not isinstance(d["env"], dict):
        raise ValueError(f"{path}: env must be an object")
    for a in d["artifacts"]:
        if not isinstance(a, dict) or not SHA.fullmatch(str(a.get("sha256", ""))) or not isinstance(a.get("size_bytes"), int) or a["size_bytes"] <= 0 or not a.get("path"):
            raise ValueError(f"{path}: artifact lacks exact path, SHA256 or size")
    return {"path": str(Path(path).resolve()), "sha256": digest(path), "descriptor": d}

        if phase not in PHASES:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown manifest phase {phase}")
        path = Path(filename).resolve()
        pin = digest(path)
        count = 0
        local_ids = set()
        for r in jsonl(path):
            row_id = r.get("id")
            if not isinstance(row_id, str) or not row_id or row_id in local_ids:
                raise ValueError(f"{path}: missing or duplicate id {row_id!r}")
            local_ids.add(row_id)
            if not isinstance(r.get("reference"), str) or not SHA.fullmatch(str(r.get("audio_sha256", ""))):
                raise ValueError(f"{path}:{row_id}: reference and exact audio_sha256 required")
            if not isinstance(r.get("audio_bytes"), int) or isinstance(r["audio_bytes"], bool) or r["audio_bytes"] <= 0:
                raise ValueError(f"{path}:{row_id}: audio_bytes required")
            if not isinstance(r.get("audio_s"), (float, int)) or isinstance(r["audio_s"], bool) or not math.isfinite(r["audio_s"]) or r["audio_s"] < 0:
                raise ValueError(f"{path}:{row_id}: finite nonnegative audio_s required")
            if not isinstance(r.get("corpus"), str) or not r["corpus"]:
                raise ValueError(f"{path}:{row_id}: explicit corpus label required")
            if row_id in manifest_rows:
                old = manifest_rows[row_id]
                for key in ("audio_sha256", "audio_bytes", "reference", "formatted_reference", "corpus", "speaker_id", "session_id", "sentence_id", "synthetic", *FAMILY_FIELDS):
                    if old.get(key) != r.get(key):
                        raise ValueError(f"Conflicting manifest row {row_id}, field {key}")
            else:
                manifest_rows[row_id] = r
            expected[phase].add(row_id)
            row_pins[row_id].add(pin)
            count += 1
        manifests.append({"path": str(path), "sha256": pin, "phase": phase, "rows": count})
    return manifest_rows, expected, manifests, row_pins


def load_results(specs, manifest, row_pins, expected):
    identities, observations, inputs, seen = {}, collections.defaultdict(list), [], set()
    for candidate, descriptor_path, filename in specs:
        identity = validate_descriptor(descriptor_path, candidate)
        if candidate in identities and identities[candidate]["sha256"] != identity["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError(f"Descriptor changed within candidate {candidate}")
        identities[candidate] = identity
        path = Path(filename).resolve()
        inputs.append({"candidate": candidate, "path": str(path), "sha256": digest(path)})
        for r in jsonl(path):
            if r.get("type") not in ("result", "error"):
                continue
            row_id = r.get("id")
            if row_id not in manifest:
                raise ValueError(f"{path}: unknown row {row_id!r}; declare all used phase manifests")
            m = manifest[row_id]
            if r.get("candidate") != candidate:
                raise ValueError(f"{path}:{row_id}: parent candidate attestation missing or different")
            if not isinstance(r.get("audio_sha256"), str) or r["audio_sha256"].lower() != m["audio_sha256"].lower() or r.get("audio_bytes") != m["audio_bytes"]:
                raise ValueError(f"{path}:{row_id}: audio pins differ or are absent")
            if r.get("manifest_sha256") not in row_pins[row_id]:
                raise ValueError(f"{path}:{row_id}: manifest attestation missing or unrecognized")
            if r.get("phase") not in PHASES or not isinstance(r.get("warmup"), bool) or not isinstance(r.get("pass_index"), int) or isinstance(r["pass_index"], bool) or r["pass_index"] < 0 or not isinstance(r.get("condition"), str) or not r["condition"]:
                raise ValueError(f"{path}:{row_id}: explicit phase/pass_index/warmup/condition required")
            if row_id not in expected.get(r["phase"], set()):
                raise ValueError(f"{path}:{row_id}: audio row not declared for phase {r['phase']}")
            key = (candidate, row_id, r["phase"], r["pass_index"], r["warmup"], r["condition"])
            if key in seen:
                raise ValueError(f"Duplicate measured observation {key}; do not overwrite or cherry-pick")
            seen.add(key)
            if r["type"] == "result" and not isinstance(r.get("text"), str):
                raise ValueError(f"{path}:{row_id}: result text is not a string")
            for key in ("inference_ms", "request_wall_ms", "input_read_ms"):
                if r.get(key) is not None and (not isinstance(r[key], (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(r[key]) or r[key] < 0):
                    raise ValueError(f"{path}:{row_id}: invalid timing {key}")
            observations[candidate].append(dict(r, source_path=str(path)))
    return identities, observations, inputs


def load_run_summaries(specs, inputs, identities, observations):
    sources = {(c, str(Path(p).resolve())) for c, p in specs}
    for item in inputs:
        path = Path(item["path"])
        if path.name.endswith(".rows.jsonl"):
            companion = path.with_name(path.name.removesuffix(".rows.jsonl") + ".run.json")
            if companion.is_file():
                sources.add((item["candidate"], str(companion)))
    records = []
    for candidate, filename in sorted(sources):
        if candidate not in identities:
            raise ValueError(f"{filename}: summary names an unknown candidate")
        summary = load_json(filename)
        identity = identities[candidate]
        if summary.get("candidate") != candidate or summary.get("descriptor_sha256") != identity["sha256"] or summary.get("descriptor") != identity["descriptor"]:
            raise ValueError(f"{filename}: exact parent descriptor attestation differs")
        ready = summary.get("ready")
        verified = isinstance(ready, dict) and ready.get("type") == "ready"
        if verified:
            for field in ("candidate", "model_id", "revision", "precision"):
                if ready.get(field) != identity["descriptor"][field]:
                    raise ValueError(f"{filename}: ready {field} differs from exact descriptor")
        records.append({"candidate": candidate, "path": filename, "sha256": digest(filename),
                        "model_identity_verified": verified, "observed": summary,
                        "interpretation": "Observed parent fields preserved verbatim. Only system GPU energy available; CPU/ANE/total energy must not be ranked."})
    for candidate, rows in observations.items():
        for row in rows:
            matches = [record for record in records if record["candidate"] == candidate
                       and record["observed"].get("manifest_sha256") == row["manifest_sha256"]
                       and record["observed"].get("phase") == row["phase"]
                       and record["observed"].get("condition") == row["condition"]]
            if not matches or (row["type"] == "result" and not any(record["model_identity_verified"] for record in matches)):
                raise ValueError(f"{row['source_path']}: no matching exact-descriptor parent run summary with verified ready identity")
    return records


def form_row(m, observation, candidate, phase, condition, processor):
    error = "missing_result" if observation is None else (str(observation.get("error") or "runner_error") if observation["type"] == "error" else None)
    raw = observation["text"] if observation is not None and error is None else ""
    native = processor.process(raw)
    final = native["final_text"]
    row = {k: m.get(k) for k in ("id", "audio_sha256", "audio_bytes", "audio_s", "reference", "formatted_reference", "corpus", "speaker_id", "session_id", "sentence_id", "synthetic", "canonical_term", "expect_term", *FAMILY_FIELDS)}
    row.update(candidate=candidate, phase=phase, condition=condition, pass_index=0, error=error,
               raw_text=raw, final_text=final, composed_text=native["composed_text"], cleaned_text=native["cleaned_text"],
               repair_events=native["repair_events"], duration_bucket=bucket(m["audio_s"]),
               raw_counts=measure(m["reference"], raw, m.get("formatted_reference")),
               final_counts=measure(m["reference"], final, m.get("formatted_reference")),
               native_postprocess_ms_observed=native["postprocess_ms"],
               native_postprocess_timing_note="Cached by unique raw text; not a per-row latency measurement")
    if isinstance(m.get("canonical_term"), str) and isinstance(m.get("expect_term"), bool):
        row["raw_term_exact"] = metrics.contains_exact_term(raw, m["canonical_term"])
        row["final_term_exact"] = metrics.contains_exact_term(final, m["canonical_term"])
    if observation:
        row["observation"] = observation
    return row


def groups(rows):
    grouped = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for r in rows:
        for corpus, duration in (("__all__", "__all__"), (r["corpus"], "__all__"), ("__all__", r["duration_bucket"]), (r["corpus"], r["duration_bucket"])):
            grouped[(r["phase"], r["condition"], corpus, duration)].append(r)
        if r["corpus"] in NATURAL_CORPORA:
            grouped[(r["phase"], r["condition"], "__natural__", "__all__")].append(r)
            grouped[(r["phase"], r["condition"], "__natural__", r["duration_bucket"])].append(r)
    return grouped


def supplied_grouping_keys(row):
    keys = []
    for field in ("speaker_id", "session_id"):
        value = row.get(field)
        if value is not None and value != "":
            keys.append((field, str(value)))
    # Sentence identity is a known dependence, never an invented speaker label.
    if row["corpus"] == "fleurs-en-us" and row.get("sentence_id") not in (None, ""):
        keys.append(("fleurs-en-us:sentence_id", str(row["sentence_id"])))
    if row.get("synthetic") is True:
        for field in FAMILY_FIELDS:
            value = row.get(field)
            if value is not None and value != "":
                keys.append((row["corpus"] + ":" + field, str(value)))
    return keys


def cluster_labels(rows):
    """Build once on every declared manifest row, never on a report cell."""
    rows = sorted(rows, key=lambda row: row["id"])
    parents = list(range(len(rows)))
    def find(i):
        while parents[i] != i:
            parents[i] = parents[parents[i]]
            i = parents[i]
        return i
    owners, row_keys = {}, {}
    for i, row in enumerate(rows):
        row_keys[row["id"]] = supplied_grouping_keys(row)
        for key in row_keys[row["id"]]:
            if key in owners:
                parents[find(i)] = find(owners[key])
            else:
                owners[key] = i
    members = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for i, row in enumerate(rows):
        members[find(i)].append(row)
    row_components, components = {}, {}
    for group in members.values():
        ids = sorted(row["id"] for row in group)
        component = "global-" + hashlib.sha256(ids[0].encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
        labels = sorted({key for row_id in ids for key in row_keys[row_id]})
        components[component] = {
            "rows": len(ids), "row_ids": ids, "corpora": sorted({row["corpus"] for row in group}),
            "supplied_labels": [{"field": field, "value": value} for field, value in labels],
            "has_known_grouping": bool(labels)}
        for row_id in ids:
            row_components[row_id] = component
    corpus_component_counts = collections.Counter(corpus for component in components.values() for corpus in component["corpora"])
    return {"method": "global_connected_supplied_label_components",
            "declared_rows": len(rows), "clusters": len(components),
            "row_components": row_components, "components": components,
            "components_per_corpus": dict(corpus_component_counts),
            "minimum_known_components_per_relevant_corpus_stratum": MIN_GROUPING_UNITS,
            "label_policy": "Build once across all declared manifests. Globally identical supplied speaker/session labels join conservatively across corpus splits; FLEURS sentence_id joins only FLEURS; synthetic family labels join only when explicitly supplied in a recognized provenance field. IDs/filenames, genders and inferred speakers/families are never grouping evidence.",
            "family_provenance_fields": list(FAMILY_FIELDS),
            "claim_scope": "frozen_row_conditional", "population_claim_permitted": False,
            "warning": "Known grouping does not prove population independence. FLEURS sentence grouping is not speaker grouping. Unlabeled rows remain unknown singleton components and cannot authorize inference."}


def ratio_metrics(a):
    def rate(n, d):
        return np.divide(n, d, out=np.full_like(n, np.nan, dtype=float), where=d > 0)
    return {"uwer": rate(a[..., 1], a[..., 0]), "cer": rate(a[..., 3], a[..., 2]),
            "strict_lexical_wer": rate(a[..., 5], a[..., 4]),
            "punctuation_micro_f1": rate(2 * a[..., 6], 2 * a[..., 6] + a[..., 7] + a[..., 8]),
            "case_overall_f1": rate(2 * a[..., 9], 2 * a[..., 9] + a[..., 10] + a[..., 11]),
            "sensitivity_keep_parenthetical_uwer": rate(a[..., 13], a[..., 12]),
            "sensitivity_keep_parenthetical_cer": rate(a[..., 15], a[..., 14])}


def point_metrics(b, c):
    bm, cm = ratio_metrics(b), ratio_metrics(c)
    def finite(value):
        return float(value) if math.isfinite(float(value)) else None
    return {name: {"baseline": finite(bm[name]), "candidate": finite(cm[name]),
                   "delta": finite(cm[name] - bm[name])} for name in bm}


def paired(base, candidate, stage, draws, seed, ni_margin, global_grouping):
    bmap = {r["id"]: r for r in base}
    cmap = {r["id"]: r for r in candidate}
    if bmap.keys() != cmap.keys():
        raise ValueError("Internal paired row sets differ")
    ordered = sorted(bmap)
    row_components = global_grouping["row_components"]
    components = global_grouping["components"]
    unit_keys = sorted({(bmap[row_id]["corpus"], row_components[row_id]) for row_id in ordered})
    unit_indices = {key: i for i, key in enumerate(unit_keys)}
    b = np.zeros((len(unit_keys), len(COUNT_FIELDS)))
    c = np.zeros_like(b)
    row_counts = np.zeros(len(unit_keys))
    for row_id in ordered:
        unit = unit_indices[(bmap[row_id]["corpus"], row_components[row_id])]
        row_counts[unit] += 1
        for target, row in ((b, bmap[row_id]), (c, cmap[row_id])):
            target[unit] += [row[stage + "_counts"][f] for f in COUNT_FIELDS]
    strata = []
    indices_by_corpus = {}
    withholding = []
    for corpus in sorted({key[0] for key in unit_keys}):
        indices = np.array([i for i, key in enumerate(unit_keys) if key[0] == corpus], dtype=int)
        indices_by_corpus[corpus] = indices
        known = sum(components[unit_keys[i][1]]["has_known_grouping"] for i in indices)
        unknown_rows = int(sum(row_counts[i] for i in indices if not components[unit_keys[i][1]]["has_known_grouping"]))
        reasons = []
        if known < MIN_GROUPING_UNITS:
            reasons.append("fewer_than_10_global_known_grouping_units_in_stratum")
        if unknown_rows:
            reasons.append("unknown_grouping_units_cannot_establish_independence")
        declared = global_grouping["components_per_corpus"][corpus]
        strata.append({"corpus": corpus, "rows": int(row_counts[indices].sum()),
                       "global_components_in_cell": len(indices), "known_global_components_in_cell": known,
                       "unknown_grouping_rows": unknown_rows, "global_components_in_declared_corpus": declared,
                       "resampling_withheld_reasons": reasons})
        withholding.extend({"corpus": corpus, "reason": reason} for reason in reasons)
    component_corpora = collections.Counter(key[1] for key in unit_keys)
    cross_corpus = sorted(component for component, count in component_corpora.items() if count > 1)
    if cross_corpus:
        # Independent stratum draws must not split a component spanning corpora.
        withholding.append({"corpus": "__pooled__", "reason": "global_component_spans_corpus_strata"})
    point = point_metrics(b.sum(axis=0), c.sum(axis=0))
    design = {"method": global_grouping["method"], "clusters": len({key[1] for key in unit_keys}),
              "global_identity_reused": True, "strata": strata, "cross_corpus_components": cross_corpus,
              "minimum_known_components_per_stratum": MIN_GROUPING_UNITS,
              "resampling_status": "withheld" if withholding else "exploratory_only",
              "withholding_reasons": withholding, "claim_scope": "frozen_row_conditional",
              "population_claim_permitted": False,
              "warning": "Ranges are not population confidence intervals or confirmatory/shipping bounds. Any ineligible corpus withholds the entire pooled range; it is never silently dropped."}
    component_points = []
    withheld_corpora = {s["corpus"] for s in strata if s["resampling_withheld_reasons"]}
    for i, (corpus, component) in enumerate(unit_keys):
        if corpus in withheld_corpora or component in cross_corpus:
            component_points.append({"corpus": corpus, "global_component": component,
                                     "rows": int(row_counts[i]), "metrics": point_metrics(b[i], c[i])})
    result = {"design": design, "rows": len(ordered), "stage": stage,
              "delta_sign": "candidate_minus_baseline", "bootstrap_samples": draws,
              "method": "paired whole-global-component percentile resampling within corpus strata, post-stratified to fixed observed corpus row counts; exploratory and unadjusted",
              "runtime_error_rows_baseline": sum(r["error"] is not None for r in base),
              "runtime_error_rows_candidate": sum(r["error"] is not None for r in candidate),
              "per_corpus_points": [{"corpus": corpus, "rows": int(row_counts[indices].sum()),
                                     "metrics": point_metrics(b[indices].sum(axis=0), c[indices].sum(axis=0))}
                                    for corpus, indices in indices_by_corpus.items()],
              "per_global_component_points_withheld_strata": component_points,
              "component_points_policy": "Point deltas only for every global component in each withheld stratum (and cross-corpus components); supplied component labels are in global_grouping. No interval or component ranking.",
              "pooling_policy": "Observed fixed design mix, not population weights. Compare screen/confirmation only per corpus; their pooled values must never be compared directly.",
              "metrics": {}, "accuracy_superiority_gate": "not_evaluated_by_this_exploratory_bootstrap"}
    samples = {name: [] for name in point}
    if not withholding:
        rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
        batch_size = min(512, max(1, 1_000_000 // max(1, len(unit_keys) * len(COUNT_FIELDS))))
        for start in range(0, draws, batch_size):
            n = min(batch_size, draws - start)
            bs = np.zeros((n, len(COUNT_FIELDS)))
            cs = np.zeros_like(bs)
            for indices in indices_by_corpus.values():
                selected = indices[rng.integers(0, len(indices), size=(n, len(indices)))]
                # Whole components stay paired. Calibration keeps each corpus's
                # observed row mass fixed despite unequal component sizes.
                calibration = row_counts[indices].sum() / row_counts[selected].sum(axis=1)
                bs += b[selected].sum(axis=1) * calibration[:, None]
                cs += c[selected].sum(axis=1) * calibration[:, None]
            x, y = ratio_metrics(bs), ratio_metrics(cs)
            for name in samples:
                samples[name].append(y[name] - x[name])
    for name, values_point in point.items():
        values = np.concatenate(samples[name]) if samples[name] else np.array([])
        finite = values[np.isfinite(values)]
        # Never discard undefined replicates or a low-unit stratum to get a bound.
        defined = not withholding and values_point["delta"] is not None and len(finite) == draws
        result["metrics"][name] = {
            **values_point,
            "percentile_95_interval": [float(v) for v in np.quantile(finite, [0.025, 0.975])] if defined else None,
            "one_sided_95_upper": float(np.quantile(finite, 0.95)) if defined else None,
            "defined_replicates": len(finite),
            "bootstrap_distribution_constant": bool(len(finite) and np.all(finite == finite[0])),
            "undefined_reason": None if defined else ("stratum_grouping_ineligible_see_design" if withholding else "zero_denominator_or_undefined_replicates")}
    wer = result["metrics"]["uwer"]
    errors = result["runtime_error_rows_baseline"] + result["runtime_error_rows_candidate"]
    result["efficiency_candidate_accuracy_noninferiority"] = {
        "margin": ni_margin, "upper_bound": wer["one_sided_95_upper"],
        "experimental_percentile_bound_pass": wer["one_sided_95_upper"] <= ni_margin if wer["one_sided_95_upper"] is not None and not errors else None,
        "confirmatory_bound": None, "not_a_shipping_promotion_decision": True,
        "withholding_reasons": withholding,
        "note": "Exploratory accuracy only versus the explicitly supplied baseline, never a population/shipping gate. A quantization/runtime-preservation claim requires a separate invocation with its matching-checkpoint baseline; no match is inferred from production. Errors withhold the NI boolean."}
    return result


def timing_summary(observations, manifest, run_summaries, candidate, expected):
    cells = {}
    for record in run_summaries:
        run = record["observed"]
        if record["candidate"] != candidate or run.get("phase") != "latency":
            continue
        offset = run.get("pass_offset", 0)
        for pass_index in range(offset, offset + run["requested_passes"]):
            for row_id in expected.get("latency", set()):
                key = (run["condition"], row_id, pass_index)
                cells[key] = {"id": row_id, "condition": key[0], "pass_index": pass_index, "type": "not_attempted"}
    for r in observations:
        if r["phase"] == "latency" and not r["warmup"]:
            key = (r["condition"], r["id"], r["pass_index"])
            if key not in cells:
                raise ValueError(f"Latency observation has no declared run/pass: {candidate} {key}")
            cells[key] = r
    grouped = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for r in cells.values():
        m = manifest[r["id"]]
        for corpus, duration in (("__all__", "__all__"), (m["corpus"], "__all__"), ("__all__", bucket(m["audio_s"])), (m["corpus"], bucket(m["audio_s"]))):
            grouped[(r["condition"], corpus, duration)].append(r)
    output = []
    for key, rows in sorted(grouped.items()):
        fields = {}
        for field in ("inference_ms", "request_wall_ms", "input_read_ms"):
            values = [r[field] for r in rows if r["type"] == "result" and not r.get("first_in_session", False) and isinstance(r.get(field), (int, float))]
            fields[field] = {"n": len(values), "p50": float(np.quantile(values, .5)) if len(values) >= 2 else None,
                             "p95": float(np.quantile(values, .95)) if len(values) >= 20 else None,
                             "p99": float(np.quantile(values, .99)) if len(values) >= 100 else None,
                             "min": min(values) if values else None, "max": max(values) if values else None,
                             "suppressed_below_n": {"p50": 2, "p95": 20, "p99": 100},
                             "claims": "descriptive observed quantiles only; no tail precision or population guarantee"}
        output.append({"condition": key[0], "corpus": key[1], "duration_bucket": key[2],
                       "expected_attempts": len(rows),
                       "attempts": sum(r["type"] != "not_attempted" for r in rows),
                       "missing_attempts": sum(r["type"] == "not_attempted" for r in rows),
                       "errors": sum(r["type"] == "error" for r in rows),
                       "ranking_eligible": all(r["type"] == "result" and not r.get("first_in_session", False) for r in rows),
                       "quantiles_conditional_on_success": any(r["type"] != "result" or r.get("first_in_session", False) for r in rows),
                       "cold_session_start_rows_excluded": sum(r["type"] == "result" and r.get("first_in_session", False) for r in rows),
                       "distinct_audio_rows": len({r["id"] for r in rows}), "fields": fields})
    return output


def determinism_summary(observations, processor):
    grouped = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for r in observations:
        if not r["warmup"]:
            grouped[(r["id"], r["phase"], r["condition"])].append(r)
    output = []
    for key, rows in sorted(grouped.items()):
        good = [r for r in rows if r["type"] == "result"]
        raw = [r["text"].encode("utf-8") for r in good]
        final = [processor.process(r["text"])["final_text"].encode("utf-8") for r in good]
        output.append({"id": key[0], "phase": key[1], "condition": key[2],
                       "attempts": len(rows), "successful_attempts": len(good), "errors": len(rows) - len(good),
                       "raw_unique_utf8": len(set(raw)), "final_unique_utf8": len(set(final)),
                       "raw_byte_deterministic": len(set(raw)) == 1 if len(raw) >= 2 else None,
                       "final_byte_deterministic": len(set(final)) == 1 if len(final) >= 2 else None,
                       "raw_sha256": sorted({hashlib.sha256(v).hexdigest() for v in raw}),
                       "final_sha256": sorted({hashlib.sha256(v).hexdigest() for v in final})})
    return {"method": "Exact UTF-8 transcript bytes, no normalization. Same row, phase and condition; postprocess is cached and does not independently retest native determinism.",
            "rows_with_at_least_two_successes": sum(r["successful_attempts"] >= 2 for r in output),
            "rows_with_fewer_than_two_successes": sum(r["successful_attempts"] < 2 for r in output),
            "groups_with_errors": sum(r["errors"] > 0 for r in output),
            "raw_nondeterministic_groups": sum(r["raw_byte_deterministic"] is False for r in output),
            "final_nondeterministic_groups": sum(r["final_byte_deterministic"] is False for r in output),
            "groups": output}


def exact_case_terms(rows):
    labeled = [r for r in rows if isinstance(r.get("canonical_term"), str) and isinstance(r.get("expect_term"), bool)]
    if not labeled:
        return None
    positive = [r for r in labeled if r["expect_term"]]
    negative = [r for r in labeled if not r["expect_term"]]
    stages = {}
    for stage in ("raw", "final"):
        matches = sum(r[stage + "_term_exact"] for r in positive)

def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def quantile(values, p, minimum):
    if len(values)<minimum:
        return None
    values=sorted(values)
    pos=(len(values)-1)*p
    lo=math.floor(pos); hi=math.ceil(pos)
    return values[lo]+(values[hi]-values[lo])*(pos-lo)


def stats(values):
    return {'n':len(values),'min':min(values) if values else None,
            'median':statistics.median(values) if values else None,
            'p50':quantile(values,.5,2),'p95':quantile(values,.95,20),
            'p99':quantile(values,.99,100),'max':max(values) if values else None}


def bucket(seconds):
    for upper,label in [(2,'<=2s'),(5,'2-5s'),(10,'5-10s'),(20,'10-20s')]:
        if seconds<=upper:
            return label
    return '>20s'

def digest(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as f:
        for part in iter(lambda: f.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
            h.update(part)
    return h.hexdigest()

assert len(records) == 24 and all(r['ggml_type'] == 0 and r['payload_bytes'] == 4096 for r in records)

    ('bark-3-pro-f16', '588afead8ca07d7eea4d3d3f4598a8c37fe62dab0e0212fb55f7444697d64d48'),

"""CPU-only HF Parakeet TDT -> exact pinned legacy GGML tensor/file contract.

This is a same-engine checkpoint comparison, not a reproduction of Photon/HF
runtime numerics. The verified stock-v3 filterbank/window/vocabulary prefix is
reused explicitly. All ASR source tensors must be consumed, with shapes and
storage precision matched to the stock converter. No model code is imported.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import struct

import numpy as np

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
STOCK = ROOT / "artifacts/ggml-org--parakeet-GGUF/ggml-parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-f16.bin"
STOCK_SHA256 = "833bffc9513b2cae867ee9e51633cfd11e4d51aaa5597c8ac02159385a2b426f"
MIN_FREE = 30 * 1024**3
VAD_SHAPES = {
    "vad_head.ctx.bias": [128], "vad_head.ctx.weight": [128, 128, 5],
    "vad_head.out.bias": [1], "vad_head.out.weight": [1, 128, 1],
    "vad_head.proj.bias": [128], "vad_head.proj.weight": [128, 1024, 1],
}
os.environ.update(HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY="1", HF_HUB_DISABLE_IMPLICIT_TOKEN="1", DO_NOT_TRACK="1")


def digest(path):
    value = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(8 * 1024**2), b""):
            value.update(block)
    return value.hexdigest()


def read_legacy_layout(path):
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        magic = struct.unpack("<I", stream.read(4))[0]
        if magic != 0x67676D6C:
            raise ValueError("not legacy GGML")
        hparams = struct.unpack("<15i", stream.read(60))
        n_mels, n_freq = struct.unpack("<2i", stream.read(8))
        mel = stream.read(n_mels * n_freq * 4)
        n_window = struct.unpack("<i", stream.read(4))[0]
        window = stream.read(n_window * 4)
        durations = list(struct.unpack("<" + "I" * hparams[13], stream.read(hparams[13] * 4)))
        n_vocab = struct.unpack("<i", stream.read(4))[0]
        vocab = []
        for _ in range(n_vocab):
            length = struct.unpack("<i", stream.read(4))[0]
            vocab.append(stream.read(length).decode("utf-8"))
        prefix_end = stream.tell()
        stream.seek(0)
        prefix = stream.read(prefix_end)
        records = []
        names = set()
        while header := stream.read(12):
            n_dims, n_name, dtype = struct.unpack("<3i", header)
            if not 0 <= n_dims <= 4 or dtype not in (0, 1):
                raise ValueError("reference must be pinned f16/f32 GGML")
            dims = struct.unpack("<" + "i" * n_dims, stream.read(n_dims * 4))
            name = stream.read(n_name).decode("utf-8")
            if name in names:
                raise ValueError("duplicate reference tensor " + name)
            names.add(name)
            n_bytes = math.prod(dims) * (4 if dtype == 0 else 2)
            records.append(dict(name=name, ggml_type=dtype, shape=list(reversed(dims))))
            stream.seek(n_bytes, 1)
        if stream.tell() != path.stat().st_size:
            raise ValueError("truncated reference tensor payload")
    return prefix, hparams, durations, vocab, records, {
        "mel_filterbank_sha256": hashlib.sha256(mel).hexdigest(),
        "window_sha256": hashlib.sha256(window).hexdigest(),
        "prefix_sha256": hashlib.sha256(prefix).hexdigest(),
        "prefix_bytes": len(prefix), "n_mels": n_mels, "n_freq": n_freq, "n_window": n_window,
    }


class SafeTensorFile:
    def __init__(self, path):
        self.path = path
        with path.open("rb") as stream:
            length = struct.unpack("<Q", stream.read(8))[0]
            self.header = json.loads(stream.read(length))
        self.data_offset = 8 + length
        self.used = set()
        self.dtypes = sorted({v["dtype"] for k, v in self.header.items() if k != "__metadata__"})
        offsets = sorted((v["data_offsets"][0], v["data_offsets"][1]) for k, v in self.header.items() if k != "__metadata__")
        cursor = 0
        for start, end in offsets:
            if start != cursor or end < start:
                raise ValueError("overlap/hole in safetensors payload")
            cursor = end
        if self.data_offset + cursor != path.stat().st_size:
            raise ValueError("safetensors payload length mismatch")

    def read(self, name):
        if name in self.used:
            raise ValueError("source tensor consumed twice: " + name)
        item = self.header[name]
        self.used.add(name)
        dtype = {"F16": "<f2", "F32": "<f4", "BF16": "<u2", "I64": "<i8"}[item["dtype"]]
        start, end = item["data_offsets"]
        if math.prod(item["shape"]) * np.dtype(dtype).itemsize != end - start:
            raise ValueError("tensor byte count mismatch: " + name)
        value = np.memmap(self.path, mode="r", dtype=dtype, offset=self.data_offset + start, shape=tuple(item["shape"]))
        if item["dtype"] == "BF16":
            return (value.astype(np.uint32) << 16).view(np.float32)
        return value.astype(np.float32)

TIMING_SCOPE = "PCM-to-final-ASR-text including reference chunking, 0.25s padding, NumPy frontend, CoreML encoder and greedy NumPy TDT decoding; WAV read/PCM conversion excluded"


def emit(stream, row):
    stream.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    stream.flush()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--model-dir", type=Path, default=ROOT / "models/barkplus/coreml/ane")
    parser.add_argument("--compiled-dir", type=Path, default=ROOT / "compiled/BarkEncoder.mlmodelc")
    parser.add_argument("--candidate", default="BarkPlus")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    # Keep a private descriptor for protocol output; redirect Python AND native
    # stdout to stderr before importing numerical/runtime libraries.
    protocol = os.fdopen(os.dup(sys.stdout.fileno()), "w", encoding="utf8", buffering=1)
    os.dup2(sys.stderr.fileno(), sys.stdout.fileno())
    sys.stdout = sys.stderr
    os.environ.update(HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY="1", HF_HUB_DISABLE_IMPLICIT_TOKEN="1", DO_NOT_TRACK="1", HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1", TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE="1")
    os.environ.setdefault("TMPDIR", str(ROOT / "cache/tmp"))
    os.environ.setdefault("XDG_CACHE_HOME", str(ROOT / "cache"))
    Path(os.environ["TMPDIR"]).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    load_start = time.perf_counter_ns()
    try:
        import importlib.metadata
        import coremltools as ct
        import numpy as np
        import soundfile as sf

        if not args.compiled_dir.is_dir():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Missing parent-precompiled encoder: {args.compiled_dir}; run compile_bark_encoder.py before launching")
        reference_path = args.model_dir / "bark_coreml.py"
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("pinned_bark_coreml_reference", reference_path)
        reference = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        spec.loader.exec_module(reference)
        encoders = {
            window: ct.models.CompiledMLModel(str(args.compiled_dir), compute_units=ct.ComputeUnit.CPU_AND_NE, function_name=f"w{window}")
            for window in reference.WINDOWS
        }

        def encode(window, features, mask):
            return encoders[window].predict({"features": features.astype(np.float16), "mask": mask})["encoded"]

        transcriber = reference.Transcriber(folder=str(args.model_dir), units="ane", encoder=encode, pad_s=0.25)
        runtime = "Python " + sys.version.split()[0] + "; " + "; ".join(
            f"{name} {importlib.metadata.version(name)}" for name in ("coremltools", "numpy", "soundfile", "soxr")
        )
    except Exception as error:
        emit(protocol, {"type": "error", "id": None, "error": f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}", "fatal": True})
        return 1
    emit(protocol, {
        "type": "ready", "candidate": args.candidate, "model_id": MODEL_ID,
        "revision": REVISION, "precision": PRECISION, "runtime": runtime,
        "load_ms": (time.perf_counter_ns() - load_start) / 1e6,
        "timing_scope": TIMING_SCOPE, "nonshipping_python_reference": True,
        "compiled_encoder": str(args.compiled_dir.resolve()),
    })
    for line in sys.stdin:
        request_id = None
        try:
            request = json.loads(line)
            request_id = request["id"]
            read_start = time.perf_counter_ns()
            audio_path = Path(request["audio_path"])
            if not audio_path.is_absolute():
                raise ValueError("audio_path must be absolute")
            with sf.SoundFile(audio_path) as source:
                if source.format not in ("WAV", "WAVEX") or source.samplerate != 16000 or source.channels != 1:
                    raise ValueError("Expected 16 kHz mono PCM WAV; runner never silently resamples/downmixes")
                if source.subtype not in ("PCM_U8", "PCM_16", "PCM_24", "PCM_32"):
                    raise ValueError(f"Expected integer PCM WAV, got subtype {source.subtype}")
                pcm = source.read(dtype="float32", always_2d=False)
            input_read_ms = (time.perf_counter_ns() - read_start) / 1e6
            inference_start = time.perf_counter_ns()
            text = transcriber.transcribe(pcm, sr=16000)
            inference_ms = (time.perf_counter_ns() - inference_start) / 1e6
            emit(protocol, {"type": "result", "id": request_id, "text": text,
                            "inference_ms": inference_ms, "audio_s": len(pcm) / 16000,
                            "input_read_ms": input_read_ms})
        except Exception as error:
            emit(protocol, {"type": "error", "id": request_id, "error": f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}", "fatal": False})
    del transcriber, encoders
    protocol.close()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
